DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_1: <color=lightblue>Enji</color>: The train is nearly complete! All I have left to finish is the warp functionality.
DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_2: I have packed away the equipment I used to make the fuel at <color=orange>Locomocean's refinery</color> as I need the space for working on a new type of <color=orange>Advanced Warp Core</color>.
DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_3: This improved version will be using Ghost Matter as opposed to singularities. Hypothetically, this new design will allow for significant jumps through space while also being able to keep the planets in tow! Not only that, the amount of time it takes to recharge after each jump is ten times faster than our current warp tech!
DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_4: My two week deadline is fast approaching. The <color=orange>One-Way Signal Blocker</color> on <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color> has bought me enough time to get everything done without interference from my clan! Time to get back to work.
DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_5: Update: I'm still on schedule for finishing the new Advanced Warp Core, but there's just one... “catch”, to put it bluntly.
DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_6: The warp pad I had been using to get into <color=orange>Locomocean's refinery</color> fell into the water after the island it was built upon collapsed.
DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_7: Now unlike that warp core I lost and substituted, I actually need this one to get inside. I don't have time to dig my way back in and risk destroying my work!
DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_8: So I got a little remote drone and went searching for the core when I noticed something strange about one of the <color=orange>anglerfish</color>: It's <color=orange>lure</color> was <color=orange>completely dark</color>.
DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_9: All of a sudden, the remote drone ended up inside the <color=orange>refinery</color>! The <color=orange>anglerfish</color> must have mistaken the warp core for food!
DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_10: When I went to go retrieve the remote drone, I couldn't seem to find the right <color=orange>anglerfish</color>. On further inspection, it would seem that the darkened lure isn't visible (even to the third eye). I can only see it with the remote drone's <color=orange>camera</color>.
DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_11: ...And somehow an <color=orange>anglerfish</color> is a perfect conduit for warp pads. I... don't know what to make of this information.
DialogueDictionary.ANGLER_WARP_HINT_TEXT_12: Despite that minor setback (and the fact that the entrance to <color=orange>Locomocean's refinery</color> is now absolutely disgusting), I should still have enough time to finish everything before my clan finds me!
DialogueDictionary.BEACON_MESSAGE_TEXT_2: <color=red>Notice</color>: Your <color=orange>Gnomai</color> Distro is outdated. Certain functions may be unavailible, such as the remote access of coordinates.
DialogueDictionary.BEACON_MESSAGE_TEXT_3: Approximate transmission coordinates may still be retrieved on-site at the <color=orange>Coordinate Relay</color>.
DialogueDictionary.BEACON_MESSAGE_TEXT_4: <color=red>ERROR</color>: Scheduled automatic cessation of <color=orange>One-Way Signal Blocker</color> following user inputed time of <color=yellow>three weeks</color> has failed. Please contact your system administrator.
DialogueDictionary.CHILD_ENJI_TEXT_2: For a long time, Nomai Clans have been using <color=orange>vessels</color> to explore the universe.
DialogueDictionary.CHILD_ENJI_TEXT_3: Every ten years, festivals happen where everyone gathers to share knowledge to learn a whole bunch of different things!
DialogueDictionary.CHILD_ENJI_TEXT_4: ...But there hasn't been a lot of transportation innovation since we all use warp cores to move around.
DialogueDictionary.CHILD_ENJI_TEXT_5: Our <color=orange>vessel</color> is nice and comfy, but I like it when I get to explore the planets we visit! I get bored of seeing the same white and silver colors and not the weird and wacky organic stuff!
DialogueDictionary.CHILD_ENJI_TEXT_6: So here's my idea: <color=orange>make a space train</color>! It has all the stuff the vessel has, but we get to have home planets in tow!
DialogueDictionary.CHILD_ENJI_TEXT_7: And we could pick up more planets, or swap them out, anything really! It would be efficient!
DialogueDictionary.CHILD_ENJI_TEXT_8: So... what do you guys think? Cool idea, right?
DialogueDictionary.COORD_CONTROL_HINT_TEXT_1: <color=lightblue>Enji</color>: I have prepared the socket for the new <color=orange>Advanced Warp Core</color> here in the engine room.
DialogueDictionary.COORD_CONTROL_HINT_TEXT_2: Once it's finished I'll be ready to take the train on its inaugural warp back to my clan!
DialogueDictionary.COORD_CONTROL_HINT_TEXT_3: After placing the <color=orange>Advanced Warp Core</color>, the <color=orange>Coordinate Interface</color> will rise up from the floor. All I need to do is enter the correct coordinates from the <color=orange>Coordinate Relay</color> and we're off!
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_2: My two weeks were almost up. In a rash attempt to get the new <color=orange>Advanced Warp Core</color> done as quickly as possible, I took minimal precautions.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_3: I know I'm supposed to follow safety procedures. I know how to properly handle <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color>. I even learned how to become temporarily immune to it.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_4: ...But what good does that information do for me when my arm's pinned down?
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_5: An explosion occurred while trying to channel the power into the core. I'm unable to pull it out on my own. My clan will have to find me. I was never against the idea of cooperation. I just needed some time alone.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_6: The <color=orange>Signal Blocker</color> should stop in a few days like I've prompted it to. Good thing I had the foresight to set that up for emergencies like this.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_7: Just have to wait. I can last a little while. The pain will make it feel like eternity, though. Perhaps I can twiddle my non-pinned limbs to pass the time, or at the very least take my mind off it.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_9: It's been a couple of days. Arm still hurts. Still can't get it unstuck. But I'm being proactive regardless!
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_10: I've used my <color=orange>remote drone</color> to retrieve equipment and supplies. It can't carry much since it's main use is for scouting, but I have nothing but time to spare.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_11: Surely the <color=orange>Signal Blocker</color> has stopped by now.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_13: It has to have been at least a week now. They must've heard the signal by now, they must have!
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_14: I can't gather any more supplies. My <color=orange>remote drone</color> got chewed on by an <color=orange>anglerfish</color>. If only I was able to catch one to chew on in revenge.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_15: Would it be disgusting? Most definitely. Wouldn't even be able to roast it. But it is starting to become more appealing by the second. And their constant groans are only making things worse.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_17: I do not know how long it has been. I can't see the sun and I have no means with which to gauge the time.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_18: What I do know is this: <color=orange>my clan isn't coming for me</color>.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_19: The supplies I accrued are dwindling, even after rationing them. The salt water I've been using to keep the <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> at bay with is beginning to run out. At this rate I'll have to start using my drinking water instead.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_20: ...I'm not sure whether the <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> will kill me first by dehydrating me or ironically by quenching my thirst.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_22: I have begun considering removing my arm. I do not have proper medical equipment; I only have what I used to mine for resources on <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color>. I can't exactly chisel myself out without injury.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_23: I cannot ascertain whether it'd be better to wither away in here or suffer complications from the amputation. Neither sound like promising options.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_24: ...The decision has been made. I can't bring myself to do it.
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_26: I just wanted to be useful...
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_27: I just wanted to make a significant contribution...
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_29: I just wanted to build a train...
DialogueDictionary.END_TEXT_30: ...Perhaps everyone knew all along and I simply refused to see. Maybe trying to put a system on rails was an idea doomed from the start.
DialogueDictionary.ENJI_PLAN_TEXT_1: <color=lightblue>Enji</color>: I finally have the opportunity to be on my own. I've been planning to do this for a while now, I just needed to wait for the right conditions.
DialogueDictionary.ENJI_PLAN_TEXT_2: Ever since my younger days when no one appreciated my dreams of space trains being the next big thing for Nomai-kind, I've been planning to get away from my clan to build it all myself.
DialogueDictionary.ENJI_PLAN_TEXT_3: I knew it could be done. I simply needed planets that were small enough with at least one of them containing <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> for use as an energy source.
DialogueDictionary.ENJI_PLAN_TEXT_4: After identifying this particular system for meeting my specifications, I quietly hijacked one of the escape pods from my <color=orange>vessel</color> and managed to leave undetected.
DialogueDictionary.ENJI_PLAN_TEXT_5: To prevent my clan from finding and stopping me before I finish construction, I've set up this <color=orange>One-Way Signal Blocker</color>. It will make it harder for them to track me down and it'll still let me get back to them once I finish the train's warp functionality.
DialogueDictionary.ENJI_PLAN_TEXT_6: But it won't stop them from looking for me. I've covered my tracks as best I could and cleared the crash site. Two uninterrupted weeks is all I ask.
DialogueDictionary.ENJI_PLAN_TEXT_7: Every time I ever brought up the fact that “I like trains” the others would groan like they'd heard it a thousand times before! (...I suppose they have. From me.)
DialogueDictionary.ENJI_PLAN_TEXT_8: ...But no one wanted to assist me, or at the very least supervise me! They'd come up with excuses like “It'd be dangerous to experiment with Ghost Matter” or “What about preserving the planets for potential future species?” There's no way we've made so many technical advancements without incurring some amount of risk.
DialogueDictionary.ENJI_PLAN_TEXT_9: Please let this buy me enough time.
DialogueDictionary.ESCAPE_EXPLAINATION_TEXT_1: <color=lightblue>Enji</color>: I've finally cleaned up the crash site. Of all the places in the universe to wind up, this is an idyllic spot.
DialogueDictionary.ESCAPE_EXPLAINATION_TEXT_2: With that said, I'm surprised that Nomai tech was already here before I showed up. Well, maybe not. Our clans are everywhere.
DialogueDictionary.ESCAPE_EXPLAINATION_TEXT_3: I was worried that someone might show up and start asking questions, but it would seem that no one's around this particular star.
DialogueDictionary.ESCAPE_EXPLAINATION_TEXT_4: Upon further inspection, there seems to be a <color=orange>derelict vessel</color> in the distance... Did something happen to this particular clan?
DialogueDictionary.ESCAPE_EXPLAINATION_TEXT_5: Surely we would have heard about something like that. It's not every day a clan chooses to abandon a <color=orange>vessel</color>.
DialogueDictionary.ESCAPE_EXPLAINATION_TEXT_6: ...Well, perhaps I might relate to that last bit.
DialogueDictionary.ESCAPE_EXPLAINATION_TEXT_7: Anyways, I've covered my tracks to the best of my ability. For now I'll rest and in the morning my project begins.
DialogueDictionary.FIRST_LAUNCH_TEXT_1: <color=lightblue>Enji</color>: Alright... Everything has been building up to this moment.
DialogueDictionary.FIRST_LAUNCH_TEXT_3: All systems are online! The engine has started!
DialogueDictionary.FIRST_LAUNCH_TEXT_5: I've secured a stable orbit around this local system's star. Now comes the challenging part.
DialogueDictionary.FIRST_LAUNCH_TEXT_7: Yes. YES! I've done it! All of the planets are now following the train's orbit!
DialogueDictionary.FIRST_LAUNCH_TEXT_8: I have successfully put a <color=orange>system on rails</color>! I knew it could be done!
DialogueDictionary.FROST_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_1: <color=lightblue>Enji</color>: I've gathered enough <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> crystals here on <color=orange>Frost Car</color>. I've also managed to finally get my hands on one of the larger crystals from the <color=orange>core</color>.
DialogueDictionary.FROST_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_2: The smaller crystals are being refined on Locomocean and will be used as the main source of power for the train. Honestly, everyone saying that Ghost Matter can be an extremely volatile substance hasn't really seemed to consider the industrial applications of the stuff.
DialogueDictionary.FROST_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_3: The larger crystal is also being taken to <color=orange>Locomocean</color>, but it will instead be used for a new <color=orange>Advanced Warp Core</color> I have been designing to surpass our current warp technology.
DialogueDictionary.FROST_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_4: I find it strange that we have been using the same old tech for thousands of years. It's as old as the tales of <color=orange>Escall's Clan</color>.
DialogueDictionary.FROST_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_5: I wonder what <color=orange>Annona</color> would think of my design...
DialogueDictionary.FROST_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_6: As I don't want to jeopardize my success by falling to my death, I've decided to block off entry to the core.
DialogueDictionary.FROST_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_7: I won't be needing to go back down, but I will eventually need to come back here for the smaller crystals. Entropy and all that it entails, you know how it is.
DialogueDictionary.FROST_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_8: <color=orange>Update</color>: The large crystal I've chosen isn't potent enough so I've returned for another. For future reference, <color=orange>the first turn after entering</color> the ice tunnels leads directly to the <color=orange>core</color>. Come to think of it, the tunnels blocked by <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> seem to be the most direct route to it.
DialogueDictionary.GM_SAFETY_TEXT_1: Enji: Well... Isn't this something I wish I had known earlier!
DialogueDictionary.GM_SAFETY_TEXT_2: I was just mining this pillar for resources to build the train when I discovered that there was an aquifer right above me.
DialogueDictionary.GM_SAFETY_TEXT_3: ...And, of course, shortly thereafter the entire upper portion of the pillar broke! I was unharmed, but a little shaken being pushed around by the ensuing flood.
DialogueDictionary.GM_SAFETY_TEXT_4: After coming to my senses, I realized I was standing in patch of <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color>! ...But I wasn't writhing in burning agony?
DialogueDictionary.GM_SAFETY_TEXT_5: Not too long after being bewildered by this, it very much started to burn, as most come to expect. But why did it take so long to start hurting me?
DialogueDictionary.GM_SAFETY_TEXT_6: It seems I have accidentally discovered a means to achieve temporary immunity to the effects of <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color>. By being completely drenched with water, I can freely touch it without worry.
DialogueDictionary.GM_SAFETY_TEXT_7: Frankly, I'm still going to be anxious standing in a cloud of <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> considering all that's between me and certain death is soggy garments.
DialogueDictionary.GM_SAFETY_TEXT_8: Further testing shows that I have about <color=orange>one minute</color> after climbing out of water to use my newfound invincibility before I dry off.
DialogueDictionary.GM_SAFETY_TEXT_9: <color=orange>Update</color>: I have reminded myself the hard way that <color=orange>water vaporizes quickly</color> in the vacuum of space. Ouch.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_FROST_TEXT_1: <color=lightblue>Enji</color>: I've finished setting up tractor beams on <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color>, <color=orange>Locomocean</color>, and <color=orange>Frost Car</color>.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_FROST_TEXT_2: Once the train is complete, the beams will remain on indefinitely to keep the planets alined and in tow.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_FROST_TEXT_3: Of course, since they give away my presence quite easily I will keep them off for now and enable them temporarily to move between the planets.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_FROST_TEXT_4: Now that I've acquired the materials I need for construction, I'll make way for <color=orange>Frost Car</color> to get my limbs on <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color>. The trick I've learned here should prove useful.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_FROST_TEXT_5: <color=orange>Update</color>: Flinging myself to <color=orange>Frost Car</color> will not suffice. Not even having a ship would help. No worries! I've implemented a solution to work around this.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_FROST_TEXT_6: It seems that while the exterior of <color=orange>Frost Car</color> is exposed to the vacuum of space, the ice tunnels beneath the <color=orange>sunward side</color> appear to have some sort of atmosphere within.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_FROST_TEXT_7: I'll make use of my warp cores to transport the <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> to <color=orange>Locomocean</color>. As I only have one <color=orange>black hole</color> warp core, I've constructed a <color=orange>warp receiver</color> within <color=orange>Frost Car</color>.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_FROST_TEXT_8: Conveniently, the cores I'm using for these warp pads <color=orange>do not</color> require an alignment window to function. Quite the timesaver, but the question has to be asked... Why hasn't anyone implemented this sooner?!
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_1: <color=lightblue>Enji</color>: An update on the current situation. I... just lost a warp core.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_2: I'm in the process of sealing off Locomocean's refinery and I brought one of the white hole cores by leaping to the planet. I hit a patch of land. On an ocean planet. Not quite the splash I was hoping to make (Ha ha. I'm in pain).
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_3: Now, I didn't break anything... I think. But I lost grip of the <color=orange>core</color> and I'm not about to go back to swimming with the fishies to find it, nor can I spare the time to. I'll grab another to use instead.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_4: If I had to guess where it was? Based on the ocean current, probably the <color=orange>South Pole</color>. But I'm not about to go digging in the sand because <color=lightblue>A)</color> I hate sand, <color=lightblue>B)</color> I hate the fish, and <color=lightblue>C)</color> I don't have time for that.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_5: I'm fortunate enough that I didn't end up losing the <color=orange>black hole</color> warp core instead. What a pain that would be!
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_6: <color=orange>Update</color>: It would seem that The Universe has it out for me. Me and my big mouth.
DialogueDictionary.SPRUCE_TO_OCEAN_TEXT_7: Wait, I'm not talking, I'm writing. Me and my... big hands? No, that sounds dumb.
DialogueDictionary.TRAIN_TEXT_1: <color=lightblue>Enji</color>: At long last, my work has come to fruition!
DialogueDictionary.TRAIN_TEXT_2: There are a two things I need to take care of before it's truly complete:
DialogueDictionary.TRAIN_TEXT_3: 1) I need to finish my work on the immense source of power for warp functionality. I'm going to prepare this at Locomocean's Refinery.
DialogueDictionary.TRAIN_TEXT_4: 2) The coordinates leading back to my clan's <color=orange>Vessel</color> need to be updated to their current position. I'll simply drop by the <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color> to find out where my clan is after I prepare the warp.
DialogueDictionary.TRAIN_TEXT_5: My two weeks are almost up. I can't wait to see the looks on their faces when I show them what I've accomplished here!
DialogueDictionary.TRAIN_WARNING_TEXT_1: <color=red>WARNING</color>: A fuel leak has been detected in the <color=orange>main corridor</color>.
DialogueDictionary.TRAIN_WARNING_TEXT_2:
Running System Diagnostics:
<color=orange>Fuel Reserves</color>: 98%
<color=orange>Structural Integrity</color>: 99.98%
<color=orange>Engine Status</color>: Fully operational
DialogueDictionary.TRAIN_WARNING_TEXT_3: The main corridor to the <color=orange>engine room</color> has been sealed to prevent further breach of containment.
DialogueDictionary.TRAIN_WARNING_TEXT_4: Remember to wear adequate equipment when dealing with hazardous materials.
DialogueDictionary.WARP_CORES_TEXT_1: <color=lightblue>Enji</color>: My suspicions were correct; that <color=orange>vessel</color> is abandoned. No one's shown up, not that I mind. It's in my best interest that I remain alone.
DialogueDictionary.WARP_CORES_TEXT_2: I have found some things they left behind. Materials, mostly. It's quite a boon! The less resources I have to gather, the faster I can get this done.
DialogueDictionary.WARP_CORES_TEXT_3: I should note that I have also found a couple of warp cores lying around. This is excellent because my first idea for getting to the other planets was just going to be flinging myself to them when the orbits align.
DialogueDictionary.WARP_CORES_TEXT_4: Unfortunately, I only have one <color=orange>black hole</color> warp core. If I had the time or the means to reach it, perhaps I could <color=orange>get more cores</color> from the <color=orange>derelict vessel</color>. They built this warp receiver on this planet, after all.
DialogueDictionary.WARP_CORES_TEXT_5: <color=orange>Update</color>: I'm going to deconstruct the warp receiver here and move it onto the train. For now it'll just lead to the <color=orange>vessel</color> (not that I can get there anyways), but I'll be able to make use of it eventually!
DialogueDictionary.WARP_CORES_TEXT_6: Perhaps I could fling myself there... no, that'd be ridiculous.
DialogueDictionary.WARP_CORES_TEXT_7: Granted, I still first need to actually get to the planets to establish warp pads. Jumping's not entirely out of the question.
DialogueDictionary.WATER_SCARY_TEXT_1: Enji: I hate being here. I hate being here!
DialogueDictionary.WATER_SCARY_TEXT_2: But... I don't really have a choice. I can't spare any time for apprehension. <color=orange>Locomocean's</color> the only place I can do this.
DialogueDictionary.WATER_SCARY_TEXT_3: I wish <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color> had a spacious spot, but I can't really refine <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> while being so close to the train.
DialogueDictionary.WATER_SCARY_TEXT_4: I have scouted the waters and located the perfect spot to build a <color=orange>refinery</color>: a spacious cavern. The fish here don't seem to be interested in it. I can at least have some sanctity within.
DialogueDictionary.WATER_SCARY_TEXT_5: <color=orange>Update</color>: I have finished a cursory version of the <color=orange>refinery</color>. I do need to be quick, after all. I don't know how much time I have before they come looking for me.
DialogueDictionary.WATER_SCARY_TEXT_6: The water has been pumped out and I have installed an airlock that permits entry.
DialogueDictionary.WATER_SCARY_TEXT_7: I still need water to reduce the effects of <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color>, but I don't need it completely dissipating.
DialogueDictionary.WATER_SCARY_TEXT_8: <color=orange>Update #2</color>: I went ahead and sealed off the cavern completely. Sand kept getting in through the airlock and it's less frustrating to just use some standard warp cores to get in and out.
DialogueDictionary.WATER_SCARY_TEXT_9: Even if the, uh... “entrance” I now have to use is slightly unorthodox.
DialogueDictionary.WHISTLE_HINT_TEXT_1: <color=lightblue>Enji</color>: I may have made it slightly convoluted for myself getting back to <color=orange>Frost Car's Core</color>, but at least I have a quick way to deal with <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color>.
DialogueDictionary.WHISTLE_HINT_TEXT_2: Speaking of which, now that the train is up and running, I've made a much needed change to put the minds of the others at ease when I ride it back to show it off.
DialogueDictionary.WHISTLE_HINT_TEXT_3: Even after going through the refinement process at <color=orange>Locomocean</color>, the fuel made with <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> still leaves trace amounts of the more hazardous bits lingering in the air.
DialogueDictionary.WHISTLE_HINT_TEXT_4: Turns out the stuff even lasts in the vacuum of space! It's coming right out of the train's whistle.
DialogueDictionary.WHISTLE_HINT_TEXT_5: To prevent the train from pumping <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> fumes out everywhere, I've set the train to blow its whistle every <color=orange>two minutes</color>.
DialogueDictionary.WHISTLE_HINT_TEXT_6: The whistle is already continously pumping out steam to counter the <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> fumes, but keeping it contained by spending a little extra water every now and then to make it completely dissipate is worth it.
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_2: Seems like you went out of your way to find me. Kinda disturbing, to be honest.
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_4: Huh. Didn't picture a silent protagonist as the talkative sort.
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_5: Hey, can I ask you a question?
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_6: Did you want to talk about something?
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_7: Why do you keep asking me about things?
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_12: Your feelings are not being reciprocated here.
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_14: The housing market's crazy because the universe is dying or something so I'm looking for a new crib.
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_15: This place is nice. Plenty of water, comes with a spacious room. Only real complaint is the noise every two minutes, but it's not too bad down here.
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_19: No, there are a bunch of posers there.
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_20: Come to think of it, there are imposters all over the place claiming to be him.
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_21: If you speak to a false Ernesto, don't get too meta.
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_TEXT_22: He'll come back to life eventually. You know all about that, don't you?
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_PLAYER_TEXT_4: Have you seen a Nomai on this planet at some point?
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_PLAYER_TEXT_15: So much for taking Gossan's advice...
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_PLAYER_TEXT_18: Cease your useless drivel, I have become bored.
DialogueDictionary.GESWALDO_PLAYER_TEXT_23: He died. I'm available for consoling.

ShipLogDictionary.SHARED_WARP_INSERTED_TEXT: The warp core I found fit perfectly!
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_FINAL_RUMOR_TEXT: I used a <color=orange>Ghost Matter Core</color> in the train's <color=orange>main engine room</color> and randomly entered coordinates.
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_FINAL_RUMOR_ALT_TEXT: I used a <color=orange>Ghost Matter Core</color> in the train's <color=orange>main engine room</color> and entered the coordinates from the <color=orange>coordinate relay</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_FINAL_FACT_TEXT: I was able to get the train's warp functionality up and running! ...At least, I would have if it weren't for the time loop.
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_FINAL_FACT_2_TEXT: <color=yellow>I saw all there was to see</color>!
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_START_BASE_TEXT: This train appears to be pulling an entire system behind it on rails!
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_START_FACT_TEXT: A Nomai named <color=lightblue>Enji</color> built this train.
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_OBJECTIVE_1_TEXT: It seems the train needs a power source from <color=orange>Locomocean's refinery</color> to enable warp functionality.
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_OBJECTIVE_2_TEXT: Coordinates leading to <color=lightblue>Enji's</color> clan are availible somewhere on <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_BLOCKED_ENTRANCE_TEXT: The main corridor leading to the <color=orange>engine room</color> has been sealed shut due to <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> leaking out.
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_ENGINEROOM_RUMOR_TEXT: The main corridor leading to the <color=orange>engine room</color> has been sealed shut due to <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> leaking out.
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_ENGINEROOM_RUMOR_ALT_TEXT: I managed to get around the sealed corridor by going through the train's whistle!
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_ENGINEROOM_START_TEXT: I gained entry to the <color=orange>engine room</color> through the train's whistle!
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_ENGINEROOM_COORDHINT_1_TEXT: A socket has been prepared for a new type of <color=orange>Advanced Warp Core</color> that <color=lightblue>Enji</color> was developing.
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_ENGINEROOM_COORDHINT_2_TEXT: Once the <color=orange>core</color> has been placed in the socket, a <color=orange>Coordinate Interface</color> will become accessible here in the <color=orange>engine room</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_ENGINEROOM_ANGLERFISH_1_TEXT: The warp pad that <color=lightblue>Enji</color> had been using to enter <color=orange>Locomocean's refinery</color> fell into the sea! It appears an <color=orange>anglerfish</color> ate the warp core it had.
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_ENGINEROOM_ANGLERFISH_2_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> tried to find the <color=orange>anglerfish</color> that ate the core with a remote drone and noticed that the <color=orange>lure</color> on one particular fish <color=orange>had gone dark</color> when the drone suddenly ended up inside the <color=orange>refinery</color>!
ShipLogDictionary.RAILWAY_ENGINEROOM_ANGLERFISH_3_TEXT: When <color=lightblue>Enji</color> went to that specific <color=orange>anglerfish</color>, the <color=orange>darkened lure</color> appeared normal to the naked eye and was only visible through the remote drone's <color=orange>camera</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_BASE_FACT_TEXT: A desolate planet of ice and snow.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_BASE_GM_TEXT: I found a series of ice tunnels beneath the planet's <color=orange>sunward</color> side. There's lots of <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> within.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_MINE_RUMOR_TEXT: I can see a structure beneath the surface on the dark side of <color=orange>Frost Car</color>, but I can't access it from here.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_MINE_RUMOR_ALT_TEXT: I found a structure beneath the surface on the dark side of <color=orange>Frost Car</color>. I reached it through ice tunnels on the planet's <color=orange>sunward</color> side.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_MINE_FACT_TEXT: This area is littered with <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> crystals.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_MINE_CRYSTALS_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> crystals were harvested from here and taken to <color=orange>Locomocean</color>. The smaller ones were used to make fuel and a larger one was going to be used to make a new and improved <color=orange>Advanced Warp Core</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_MINE_WARP_RUMOR_TEXT: The warp pad here seems to be missing a <color=orange>white hole</color> warp core.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_MINE_COREHINT_1_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> blocked off the core to avoid falling down, but noted that the <color=orange>first turn</color> at the entrance to the ice tunnels leads directly there.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_MINE_COREHINT_2_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> also noticed that the tunnels blocked by <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> seem to forge a more direct route to the core.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_CORE_FACT_TEXT: I managed to reach the core of <color=orange>Frost Car</color>!
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_CORE_SCROLL_ALT_TEXT: A scroll describing the train's whistle was found here.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_CORE_WHISTLEHINT_RUMOR_TEXT: I found a scroll within <color=orange>Frost Car's</color> core.
ShipLogDictionary.FROSTCAR_CORE_WHISTLEHINT_FACT_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> set up the train's <color=orange>whistle</color> to sound off every <color=orange>two minutes</color>. More steam is pumped through during this time to <color=orange>dissipate excess</color><color=lightblue> Ghost Matter </color><color=orange>fumes</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_BASE_FACT_TEXT: An ocean in motion! It's just a tad dark.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_BASE_SCROLL_1_TEXT: A <color=orange>refinery</color> was built in a cavern within <color=orange>Locomocean</color>. <color=lightblue>Enji</color> sealed it off and used warp cores to get in and out.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_BASE_SCROLL_2_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> considers the method for getting inside the <color=orange>refinery</color> to be “slightly unorthodox”.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_WARPCORE_RUMOR_TEXT: A <color=orange>white hole</color> warp core might be buried under the sand on <color=orange>Locomocean's South Pole</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_WARPCORE_FACT_TEXT: I found a <color=orange>white hole</color> warp core buried under the sand on the <color=orange>South Pole</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_CORE_OBJECTIVE_RUMOR_TEXT: The train needs a power source from <color=orange>Locomocean's refinery</color> to enable warp functionality.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_CORE_RUMOR_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> crystals were harvested from <color=orange>Frost Car</color> and refined at <color=orange>Locomocean</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_CORE_SCROLL_RUMOR_TEXT: A <color=orange>refinery</color> was built in a cavern within <color=orange>Locomocean</color>. <color=lightblue>Enji</color> sealed it off and used warp cores to get in and out.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_CORE_WARP_RUMOR_TEXT: An <color=orange>anglerfish</color> ate a warp core leading to the <color=orange>refinery</color>!
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_CORE_SCOUT_TEXT: My scout suddenly appeared in a large chamber!
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_CORE_CHEATER_TEXT: How did I get in here?
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_CORE_FACT_TEXT: I entered an <color=orange>anglerfish</color> and wound up at <color=orange>Locomocean's refinery</color>!
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_CORE_WARPCORE_TEXT: I've found an <color=orange>Advanced Warp Core</color> containing <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color>. I ought to be careful with this...
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_ENJI_FACT_2_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> was trying to meet a <color=yellow>two week</color> deadline, circumventing procedures and ignoring personal safety in favor of quick development.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_ENJI_FACT_3_TEXT: An explosion occurred, causing a chunk of <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> to pin <color=lightblue>Enji</color> down!
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_ENJI_FACT_4_TEXT: Despite being stuck, <color=lightblue>Enji</color> was still able to get supplies by using their <color=orange>remote drone</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_ENJI_FACT_5_TEXT: An <color=orange>anglerfish</color> destroyed the drone, forcing <color=lightblue>Enji</color> to ration their supplies.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_ENJI_FACT_6_TEXT: After at least <color=yellow>three weeks</color> had passed, <color=lightblue>Enji</color> began to think that their clan wouldn't come find them.
ShipLogDictionary.LOCOMOCEAN_ENJI_FACT_7_TEXT: Between withering away and attempting amputation, <color=lightblue>Enji</color> chose the former.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_BASE_FACT_TEXT: Lush and green. The gravity here is higher than what I'm used to.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_BASE_FROSTCAR_1_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> found ice tunnels beneath the <color=orange>sunward side</color> of <color=orange>Frost Car</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_BASE_FROSTCAR_2_TEXT: The exterior of <color=orange>Frost Car</color> is exposed to the vacuum of space, but the interior has its own atmosphere.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PLATFORM_RUMOR_TEXT: There's a flat space nestled amongst the hills a short distance from the <color=orange>North Pole</color> of <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PLATFORM_FACT_TEXT: A flat space nestled amongst the hills.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PLATFORM_ESCAPECLEANUP_TEX: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> crash-landed here, but cleaned up the crash site. They're covering their tracks.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PLATFORM_SCROLL_TEXT: There's a scroll on top of one of the hills.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PLATFORM_SCROLL_ALT_TEXT: A scroll with <color=lightblue>Enji's</color> idea for constructing a space train was found atop one of the hills.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PLATFORM_CORES_1_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> suspected that the <color=orange>derelict vessel</color> at the center of all these systems might contain additional warp cores.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PLATFORM_CORES_2_TEXT: A warp receiver linked to the <color=orange>derelict vessel</color> was moved from here to the train.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PLATFORM_LOSTCORE_1_TEXT: While trying to set up warp pads between <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color> and <color=orange>Locomocean</color>, <color=lightblue>Enji</color> ended up losing a <color=orange>white hole</color> warp core to the sea.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PLATFORM_LOSTCORE_2_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> used a spare warp core instead. They theorized that the dropped core might have ended up <color=orange>buried under the sand</color> on the <color=orange>South Pole</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PLATFORM_WARP_RUMOR_TEXT: The warp pad here seems to be missing a <color=orange>black hole</color> warp core.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_VESSEL_PLATFORM_RUMOR_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> suspected that the <color=orange>derelict vessel</color> at the center of all these systems might contain additional warp cores.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_VESSEL_PLATFORM_FACT_TEXT: I found a <color=orange>black hole</color> warp core on the <color=orange>derelict vessel</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_ENJI_PROJECT_1_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> proposed an idea for constructing a train capable of transporting not just its passengers, but entire groups of planets!
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_ENJI_PROJECT_2_TEXT: It appears the idea was met with some skepticism.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_ENJI_PROJECT_3_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> decided to quietly leave their clan to attempt working alone. They needed planets that were small enough for their specifications and at least one of them needed to have <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_ENJI_PROJECT_4_TEXT: A <color=orange>One-Way Signal Blocker</color> was set up to prevent <color=lightblue>Enji's</color> clan from getting in the way while also allowing <color=lightblue>Enji</color> to know how to get back to them after the train was completed.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_ENJI_PROJECT_5_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> hoped that this would provide <color=yellow>two weeks</color> to complete the train.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PILLAR_RUMOR_TEXT: There's a hollowed out pillar on the equator of <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PILLAR_START_TEXT: A hollowed out pillar. It seems all entrances are covered with <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PILLAR_OBSERVATION_TEXT: I can see a deep pit of water within <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PILLAR_IMMUNITY_1_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> discovered that if you're <color=orange>drenched with water</color>, you are temporarily immune to the effects <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> for roughly <color=orange>one minute</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_PILLAR_IMMUNITY_2_TEXT: <color=lightblue>Enji</color> also learned the hard way that <color=orange>water quickly vaporizes</color> in the vacuum of space.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_MOUNTAIN_RUMOR_TEXT: There's a hollow mountain on the equator of <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_MOUNTAIN_START_TEXT: A hollowed mountain. There's <color=lightblue>Ghost Matter</color> within.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_MOUNTAIN_OBSERVATION_TEXT: I can see a platform up high in the mountain.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_MOUNTAIN_OBSERVATION_ALT_T: I was able to reach a platform that was up high in the mountain.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_MOUNTAIN_AUDIO_RUMOR_TEXT: I can hear something coming from high up in the mountain.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_MOUNTAIN_AUDIO_FACT_TEXT: I found a signal on <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_MOUNTAIN_AUDIO_FACT_ALT_TE: I found a signal on <color=orange>Spruce Caboose</color> leading to a <color=orange>Coordinate Relay</color>.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_MOUNTAIN_TOP_1_TEXT: I found a <color=orange>One-Way Signal Blocker</color>. It appears to have some issues with its function. An error message reads the following:
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_MOUNTAIN_TOP_2_TEXT: <color=red>ERROR</color>: Scheduled automatic cessation of <color=orange>One-Way Signal Blocker</color> following user inputed time of <color=yellow>three weeks</color> has failed.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_MOUNTAIN_SCROLL_TEXT: There's a scroll ontop of the platform.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_MOUNTAIN_SCROLL_ALT_TEXT: A scroll detailing <color=lightblue>Enji's</color> plan was found here.
ShipLogDictionary.SPRUCECABOOSE_COORDS_FACT_TEXT: I managed to find a set of <color=orange>coordinates</color>!

UIDictionary.CREDIT_VOLUME_TEXT:
Somewhere, somehow, a Nomai clan witnesses something once deemed impossible...
If only there weren't a time loop.
